description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for a reftable data structure, including initialization functions, and includes references to related components such as blocks, records, and iterators.

methods.name: reftable_table_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the given reftable table.

methods.name: table_init_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for the reftable table, specifying the table, iterator, and type.

methods.name: table_init_block
methods.description: Initializes a block from the table starting at a specific offset and with desired type.
